mapper.sql: r.id, r.ferrule_sku, r.ferrule_name, r.layer_scope, r.bore_code, r.skin_type, r.qty, r.location_id, l.location_code, l.location_name, r.cost_price, r.remark, s.nickname, s.inch
LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = r.location_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bore_code, MIN(nickname) AS nickname, MIN(inch) AS inch FROM wms_hose_spec GROUP BY bore_code ) s ON s.bore_code = r.bore_code
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM wms_hose_ferrule r
AND (r.ferrule_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.ferrule_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY FIELD(r.layer_scope, '1层/2层', '3层', '4层', '6层'), CAST(r.bore_code AS UNSIGNED), r.skin_type

SELECT FROM wms_hose_ferrule r
WHERE r.layer_scope = #{layerScope} AND r.bore_code = #{boreCode}
AND r.skin_type IN (#{skinType}, '不分')
ORDER BY FIELD(r.skin_type, #{skinType}) DESC
LIMIT 1
